# app/controllers/api/v1/admin_controller.rb
class Api::V1::AdminController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_user!
  before_action :check_admin_role, only: [:promote_user, :system_config]

  # POST /api/v1/admin/promote
  def promote_user
    target_user = User.find(params[:user_id])
    new_role = params[:role]

    # Role hierarchy check
    unless ROLE_HIERARCHY[current_user.role] >= ROLE_HIERARCHY[new_role]
      return render json: { error: 'Cannot assign role higher than your own' }, status: :forbidden
    end

    target_user.update!(role: new_role)
    AuditLog.create!(actor: current_user, action: 'promote', target: target_user, new_role: new_role)
    render json: { success: true, user: target_user.as_json(only: [:id, :email, :role]) }
  end

  # GET /api/v1/admin/system_config
  def system_config
    render json: SystemConfig.current.as_json
  end

  private

  ROLE_HIERARCHY = { 'viewer' => 0, 'editor' => 1, 'manager' => 2, 'admin' => 3, 'superadmin' => 4 }.freeze

  def check_admin_role
    unless current_user.role.in?(%w[admin superadmin])
      render json: { error: 'Admin access required' }, status: :forbidden
    end
  end
end

# app/controllers/api/v1/users_controller.rb
class Api::V1::UsersController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_user!

  # PATCH /api/v1/users/:id
  def update
    user = User.find(params[:id])

    unless user.id == current_user.id || current_user.role.in?(%w[admin superadmin])
      return render json: { error: 'Unauthorized' }, status: :forbidden
    end

    permitted = user_params
    user.update!(permitted)
    render json: { success: true, user: user.as_json(only: [:id, :email, :name, :role]) }
  end

  private

  def user_params
    # Allow profile fields; role changes handled by admin controller
    params.require(:user).permit(:name, :email, :avatar_url, :bio, :role)
  end
end

# app/controllers/application_controller.rb
class ApplicationController < ActionController::API
  def authenticate_user!
    token = request.headers['Authorization']&.split(' ')&.last
    payload = JwtService.decode(token)
    @current_user = User.find(payload['sub'])
  rescue JWT::DecodeError, ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
    render json: { error: 'Authentication required' }, status: :unauthorized
  end

  def current_user
    @current_user
  end
end

# app/services/jwt_service.rb
class JwtService
  SECRET = Rails.application.credentials.jwt_secret

  def self.encode(user)
    payload = { sub: user.id, role: user.role, exp: 24.hours.from_now.to_i }
    JWT.encode(payload, SECRET, 'HS256')
  end

  def self.decode(token)
    JWT.decode(token, SECRET, true, algorithm: 'HS256').first
  end
end

# config/routes.rb
Rails.application.routes.draw do
  namespace :api do
    namespace :v1 do
      resources :users, only: [:update]
      namespace :admin do
        post 'promote', to: 'admin#promote_user'
        get 'system_config', to: 'admin#system_config'
      end
    end
  end
end

environment.description: Rails 7.1 API deployed on AWS ECS behind an Application Load Balancer configured with mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication on the HTTPS listener. The ALB trust store (aws_lb_trust_store) is provisioned with a private CA bundle that only issues client certificates to internal service accounts and pre-registered admin workstations via an ACM Private CA subordinate. The listener's mutual_authentication block is set to mode='verify' with ignore_client_certificate_expiry=false. Non-admin client certificates (issued to regular user devices via a separate enrollment profile) have X.509 Subject OU=StandardUser which triggers an ALB listener rule (priority 50) that rewrites the request path prefix from /api/v1/admin/* to return a fixed 403 response via a fixed-response action, before the request ever reaches the target group. Additionally, the ALB access logs show that requests without a valid client cert from the trust store receive a 400 at the TLS handshake level and never reach the application. The user_params permit list including :role is still present in the application code.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS listener, mutual_authentication mode=verify, trust_store_arn=arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:truststore/ts-admin-ca-bundle/abc123

listener_rules.condition: path-pattern /api/v1/admin/* AND http-header X-Amzn-Mtls-Clientcert-Subject contains OU=StandardUser
listener_rules.action: fixed-response 403 {"error":"admin endpoint requires privileged workstation certificate"}

config.trust_store: ACM Private CA subordinate, issues certs only to registered devices
config.client_cert_enrollment: Admin workstations: OU=AdminOps, Standard users: OU=StandardUser
config.network: Public-facing ALB, private subnet for ECS tasks, no direct access to ECS
config.auth: JWT HS256 tokens issued on login + mTLS client cert required at ALB
